working: Traffic roughly doubled in the last 30 days: 1,132 sessions vs 547 in the prior 30-day period (+107%), driven mostly by Direct (214 -> 716, +235%).
Organic Search grew 40% period-over-period (220 -> 307 sessions) and holds 33.1% of the full 1,100-day window (10,762 of 32,505 sessions), keeping SEO the #1 earned channel.

The Alumni list is by far the healthiest audience: Alumni eNews - July 2026 (07-09) posted a 57.3% open rate and +77.2% session lift on only 1,028 sends, and Alumni eNews - Reminder July 2026 (07-16) held 46.77% open with the best recent click rate at 1.06%.
Open rates across all 100 tracked campaigns average 51.62%, far above the 25-35% health/nonprofit benchmark - the subject lines and sender reputation are not the problem.
Event-themed sends remain the strongest click drivers on record: Client eNews December(2) hit 10.17% click / 19.35% click-to-open, and 2024 Alumni Events November hit 4.80% click on a 63.06% open.
not_working: UTM leakage is total. Email accounts for just 19 of 32,505 window sessions (0.1%), while Direct holds 51.3%. Every recent send shows the pattern - the 07-16 Alumni reminder logged 4 email sessions vs 35 direct in the same 3-day window, and the 07-20 pair logged 2 email vs 21 direct. Newsletter links carry no UTM tags, so GA4 credits Email traffic to Direct.

Constant Contact has gone silent: most_recent_send is still 2026-07-20, a 30-day gap with zero sends. The live CC refresh also failed again this run with 401 invalid_client (token refresh rejected), so all CC figures are cached at 7/20 and will not move until the OAuth app credentials are re-authorized.

The two 07-20 sends both posted negative lift (-27.3%): Staff-Client eNews - July 2026 reached 8,906 recipients but converted at only 0.43% click / 0.89% click-to-open, the weakest click rate of any recent send.

Click rates sit well below benchmark across the board - the 100-campaign average is 1.94% and recent sends run 0.43-1.06%, versus a 2-3% healthy range. High opens plus low clicks means the content is being read but not acted on.
Organic Social has collapsed to 2.2% of last-30-day traffic (25 of 1,132 sessions), down from 3.2% over 60 days and 5.3% over the full window - below the 5% floor and shrinking.

GSC 7-day snapshot is weak: 10 clicks on 1,593 impressions across 71 pages at an impression-weighted average position of 17.96 - page 2 territory. (Note: the prior run reported a 30-day GSC window, so the 49-click/13.48-position figures are not directly comparable.)
do_next: Re-authorize the Constant Contact OAuth app first - the 401 invalid_client means the client secret is stale, and every newsletter metric on the dashboard has been frozen at 2026-07-20 for 30 days. See CONSTANT-CONTACT-SETUP.md.

Add utm_source=constantcontact&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=<send-name> to every link in the CC templates before the next send. Until then the ~51% of traffic sitting in Direct cannot be split between newsletter, GBP, and true direct, and email ROI is unmeasurable.

Resume the monthly cadence - there has been no send since 07-20. Prioritize the Alumni list (1,028 sends producing +77.2% lift at 57.3% open) over the 8,906-recipient Staff-Client blast that produced -27.3% lift at 0.43% click.

Repromote event-format content. The strongest click performers on record are event announcements (10.17% and 4.80% click), while general eNews digests run under 1.1% - lead the next send with a single dated alumni event and one CTA above the fold.

SEO follow-up: at an average position of 17.96 on 1,593 weekly impressions, the site is one page short of clicks. Pull the page-level GSC report for the 71 impression-earning URLs and prioritize on-page work for anything sitting in positions 8-20.

Organic Social needs a decision - at 25 sessions in 30 days it is not currently returning on effort. Either commit to a posting cadence with tracked links or reallocate that time to the email and SEO channels that are moving.
summary: Site traffic doubled over the last 30 days (1,132 vs 547 sessions) on the back of a 235% Direct surge and 40% Organic Search growth, but the newsletter program has been dark since 2026-07-20 and the Constant Contact connector is still failing on a 401 invalid_client, so email data is frozen. The single highest-value fix remains UTM tagging: Email shows 0.1% of sessions against Direct's 51.3%, which means the newsletter's real contribution is being mis-credited and cannot be defended.
